captions.caption: A tan military tank is positioned on a metal transport platform.
Multiple tan armored vehicles are lined up on a concrete lot next to a train.
A soldier in camouflage and a high-visibility vest stands near the armored vehicles.
One of the armored vehicles slowly drives forward on the concrete pavement.
The armored vehicle continues moving, with a white passenger train visible on the left.
The vehicle maneuvers on the lot, preparing to be loaded onto the transport train.
A soldier walks alongside the moving vehicle, monitoring its progress.
The tan armored vehicle moves towards the loading ramp at the end of the lot.
A close-up view of the vehicle's tracks as it turns on the concrete surface.
A soldier in full uniform and safety vest uses hand signals to guide the driver.
The soldier raises both hands in the air, signaling the driver to move forward.
He continues to use hand signals, guiding the large vehicle onto the metal ramp.
The soldier moves his hands in a rhythmic motion to direct the vehicle's speed.
He keeps his eyes on the vehicle, ensuring it aligns correctly with the ramp.
The soldier signals for the driver to stop as the vehicle reaches a specific point.
He lowers his arms after the vehicle is successfully positioned on the platform.
The scene shifts to a soldier standing on top of a train flatcar, signaling.
The soldier on the flatcar raises his arms to guide an approaching vehicle.
He uses large, clear hand motions to direct the driver of the armored vehicle.
The soldier signals for the vehicle to continue moving along the connected flatcars.
He keeps his hands raised, carefully watching the vehicle's alignment on the narrow cars.
The soldier signals for a slight adjustment in the vehicle's direction.
He points to his left, indicating where the driver should aim the vehicle.
The soldier signals for the vehicle to stop moving forward on the flatcar.
He adjusts his signals, guiding the vehicle to its final resting spot.
The soldier remains in position, ensuring the vehicle is perfectly centered.
He lowers his hands and begins to walk away as the vehicle stops.
An armored vehicle slowly drives across the gap between two train flatcars.
The vehicle's weight causes the metal flatcars to shift slightly as it crosses.
The tan vehicle continues its slow crawl down the line of transport cars.
A side view of the armored vehicle as it moves steadily along the train.
The vehicle's tracks clank against the metal surface of the transport cars.
The turret and upper hull of the vehicle are visible as it passes by.
The vehicle moves past a soldier who is standing on the side of the tracks.
The rear of the armored vehicle is shown as it moves further away.
The vehicle continues moving slowly, nearing its designated spot on the train.
A view of the vehicle's rear armor and various equipment mounted on it.
The vehicle's engine hums as it maintains a steady, slow speed.
It crosses another junction between two flatcars in the long transport train.
The vehicle's massive size is apparent as it occupies the width of the flatcar.
The tracks grip the metal floor, providing traction for the slow movement.
The vehicle's rear markings and lights are visible as it continues forward.
It moves further down the line, with other military vehicles visible in the background.
The vehicle is almost at its final position on the transport train.
It moves a few more feet, guided by soldiers not visible in this frame.
The armored vehicle comes to a complete stop on the flatcar.
A view of the stationary vehicle's rear end after it has finished moving.
The vehicle sits securely on the train, ready to be tied down for transport.
The scene shows the back of the tank as it remains stationary on the car.
A wider shot shows the line of vehicles already loaded onto the train.
The transport train is filled with various tan-colored military vehicles.
Another armored vehicle begins its ascent up the loading ramp.
The front of the vehicle tilts upward as it starts climbing the metal ramp.
The vehicle moves steadily up the ramp, its tracks gripping the metal surface.
It reaches the top of the ramp and levels out onto the first flatcar.
The vehicle continues forward, moving from the ramp onto the train deck.
The sound of the tracks on the metal deck is audible as it moves.
The armored vehicle moves slowly and carefully, aligning with the flatcar.
A front-side view of the vehicle as it begins its journey along the train.
The vehicle continues its slow progress, moving towards the other loaded cars.
